prompts.prompt: For Route 53 DNSSEC signing, in which AWS region must the KMS key used for the key-signing key reside, no matter where the hosted zone itself is served from? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/route53/SKILL.md - DNSSEC: KSK customer-managed via AWS KMS (must be in us-east-1, ECC_NIST_P256)

prompts.prompt: With Route 53 multivalue answer routing, what is the maximum number of healthy records it will return in response to a single DNS query? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/route53/SKILL.md - Multivalue Answer: Up to 8 healthy records per query

prompts.prompt: Can you create a CNAME record at the zone apex, such as the bare domain example.com, in Route 53? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/route53/SKILL.md - Common Pitfalls: CNAME at zone apex - Route 53 does not allow CNAME at zone apex. Use Alias record instead
